# Native Screens

> Family-owned screen enclosure and pool enclosure company serving Broward County and all of South Florida since 1972. Licensed and insured. Phone: (954) 966-0163.

Native Screens builds and repairs pool enclosures (pool cages), screen enclosures, screen rooms, and patios, and installs aluminum roofs and super gutters across South Florida. The owner, Larry, runs the business directly — not a franchise or chain. Free, no-pressure estimates.

- Business: Native Screens
- Founded: 1972 (50+ years)
- Phone: (954) 966-0163
- Area served: Broward County (Fort Lauderdale, Hollywood, Pembroke Pines, Coral Springs, Davie, Plantation, and more), Miami-Dade County, and Palm Beach County
- Rating: 5.0 on Google
- Services: Rescreens & screen repair, Screen enclosures, Pool enclosures, Aluminum roofs, Super gutters

## Services
- [Pool Enclosures in South Florida](https://www.nativescreens.com/pool-enclosures-south-florida.html): Custom pool cages — new builds, replacements, and rescreens, built to Florida code.
- [Rescreens & Screen Repair](https://www.nativescreens.com/rescreens-screen-repair.html): Torn, sagging, or sun-rotted screens replaced fast, often in a day, reusing your existing frame.
